from solution import remove_Char


def test_issue_example_aba():
    """Remove all occurrences of a character in a given string."""
    result = remove_Char("aba", "a")
    expected = "b"  # 3 chars - 2 x 'a' = 1 char -> "b"
    assert result == expected

    result = remove_Char("abaca", "a")
    expected = "bc"  # 5 chars - 3 x 'a' = 2 chars -> "bc"
    assert result == expected
